title: Faction Knowledge Pack
description: Machine-enforced contract for a Faction Knowledge Pack (root ROADMAP.md Phase 7; see FACTION_KNOWLEDGE_PACKS.md for field semantics and knowledge_packs/examples/faction.example.json for a neutral, non-canonical example). A pack is optional, curated guidance that biases the Gap Recommendation Engine (GAP_RECOMMENDATION_ENGINE.md) toward faction-thematic solutions -- it can never override hard legality, and every guidance section carries its own basis/confidence rather than one pack-wide number.

example_only.description: Present and true only on neutral, non-canonical worked examples (e.g. knowledge_packs/examples/faction.example.json), never on a real pack. A loader should treat the presence of this key as true as a strong signal to keep the pack out of any bundled/user pack directory scan, regardless of its own value.

basisSource.description: Where one section's guidance actually came from. Not a legality claim -- see FACTION_KNOWLEDGE_PACKS.md section 6 (score vs confidence) and Agent.md's evidence-provenance rule.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema the pack was authored against (e.g. "1.0"), independent of pack_version and target_mod_version. Loaders may need a migration path between schema_version values in the future -- not implemented in v1 (only 1.0 exists).

pack_version.description: The pack content's own version, independent of schema_version and the target mod's version.

source_hashes.description: Maps a real, resolvable evidence key (e.g. "faction:<id>", "hull:<id>") to the SHA-256 source_hash that entity had when this pack was authored, exactly matching core/models.py Entity.source_hash. Used for freshness assessment (FACTION_KNOWLEDGE_PACKS.md section 12) by comparing against the entity's current real hash -- never a fabricated or estimated hash.

traits.description: Free-text thematic descriptors (e.g. "armor-heavy", "ballistic", "attrition", "salvage-oriented"). Descriptive framing only -- never consulted by validation/legality.py or treated as a mechanical fact.

hull_id.description: Runtime-local hull id, e.g. "example_hull" -- never a display name. Not guaranteed to resolve against every installation; see the loader's unresolved-reference handling.

approvedEquipment.description: Curated permission for an otherwise non-native item. This is access/doctrine guidance only: it never bypasses slot, OP, hullmod, fighter-bay, or any other hard legality check.
